capabilities: Chat with AI models inside any note
Provide context by referencing notes with wiki links
Create and apply reusable AI agent personas
Approve tool calls to search the vault and browse the web
Switch between providers, models, and streaming options
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not ChatGPT-only; it also supports Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Z.AI, and local models via Ollama and LM Studio.
extras: Extensive credential-migration and privacy notes with a SECURITY.md for vulnerability reporting; beta versions available via the BRAT plugin; requires Obsidian 1.11.4 or newer for secure key storage. Cloud providers receive chat messages and linked-note content; local providers keep data on the machine.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to chat with language models or use vault notes as conversation context, so users must copy text between apps.
